lessons.title: Why Computers Need Python
lessons.text: A program is a list of instructions a machine can run. Human speech is too loose. Python is a high-level language: closer to English than to ones and zeros.
lessons.concept: Python bridges human intent and raw hardware architecture as a readable high-level language.
lessons.instructorExplanation: Hey friends! Welcome to Python. Computers only speak binary zeros and ones, which is nearly impossible for humans to write efficiently. Python acts as our universal translator, letting us write clean English-like statements that turn into machine actions.
